summary: An accessibility element map, a screen reader with earcons and speech, an AT-SPI bridge, zoom, display options and switch scanning exist. Touch exploration, custom rotors, accessibility containers and the assistive-technology status queries are missing or desktop oriented.
rea_evidence: not captured: tools/parity/rea-page.sh reported 'no CDP browser on 127.0.0.1:9333 (run: tools/parity/rea-page.sh --start)'; facts are from tools/parity/docc.py

features.note: View::ax_node and Window::ax_tree give a labelled element tree; ViewApp reports it to the shell
reader walks the tree, speaks and plays earcons; Ctx::announce posts announcements. No touch exploration (touch to hear, double tap to activate), which the tablet needs
press and set value actions; no custom actions list
item navigation by headings, links and custom rotors
a point-by-point cursor exists for charts only; no general table container
floating button and system shortcuts in the shell
screen zoom in the shell; apps cannot report the focus area

reduce transparency, increase contrast, button shapes (differentiate without colour) and dim flashing lights reach apps; reduce motion is a decision model without a setting that feeds it; bold text is not exposed
braille translation model; no reading content protocol
audit model over the element tree

gaps: Touch exploration mode for the screen reader
Reduce motion, bold text and button shapes settings for apps
